title: Cranberry Sauce

adjustment.analysis: No events, promotions, or price changes in the target week. The baseline already reflects recent trends and seasonal patterns. Past Memorial Day (week before) showed a noise-adjusted lift of x1.0, so no uplift is justified. The 2026-02-23 promotion had a 30% discount and lifted sales to x1.48 vs baseline, but the following week (2026-03-02) saw a drop to x0.68, indicating pantry loading. This week's price is unchanged at $2.85, no new promotion. No evidence supports a move from baseline. The classical uplift model’s x1.0 is well-calibrated.
